target: Marginal distribution of cumulative portfolio log return at every native observed forecast lead
lead_index: d=1,...,H indexes native observed endpoints, not elapsed calendar days
scale_information: Only the training prefix available at the forecast date; identical scale for candidate and baseline
zero_or_invalid_training_scale: Fail closed and disclose; do not substitute held-out statistics or an arbitrary epsilon

internal_learning.information: Each historical validation forecast is fitted to its own earlier prefix. Outcomes must mature within the outer training history; no outer test data enters selection.
internal_learning.normalization: The qualified reference sums daily normalized CRPS over its common-length internal folds. Dividing every coefficient by the common H yields the stated mean and the same mathematical optimum; exact sum arithmetic is preserved for numerical parity.
internal_learning.requested_horizon: Requested horizon enters internal validation construction. Any shortening for available history is disclosed.
internal_learning.internal_count_scope: Current qualified reference only; a count change requires matched accuracy qualification, not an untested speed shortcut

aggregation.order: Equal origins within series/quarter; equal series within family; equal families within asset class; equal classes within branch; equal asset and portfolio branches in supported quarters; equal quarters
aggregation.single_branch_quarters: Asset-only quarters retain full asset weight

comparison.baselines: Both frozen TestFolio-style joint-asset block configurations, with and without replacement
comparison.reference_rule: Worse full-panel score of the two configurations on identical successful coverage, fixed after pair verification under this protocol
comparison.historical_reference: With replacement; full-pair reaggregation under the new protocol remains required
comparison.display_percent: 100*(1-Q_candidate/Q_reference); positive means better, negative means worse

interpretation.academic_claim: Proper marginal CRPS with positive past-only scaling and fixed positive aggregation weights; a defensible application-specific protocol, not a uniquely prescribed academic standard
interpretation.sqrt_lead: A reference uncertainty unit, not an assumption that markets actually follow a random walk

launch_gate: Complete-request profiling, numerical parity qualification, scoring/coverage review, and storage admission before full-panel launch
production_claim_boundary: Local research request timings do not establish deployed website click-to-visible latency
